From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

The Heinz Hopf Prize is awarded every two years at [ETH Zurich](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ETH_Zurich). The prize honours outstanding scientific work in the field of [pure mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pure_mathematics). It is named after the German mathematician [Heinz Hopf](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Heinz_Hopf) (1894–1971), Professor of Mathematics at ETH from 1931 to 1965. The prize is awarded on the occasion of the Heinz Hopf Lectures that are given at ETH by the laureate.[[1]](#cite_note-1)

The prize was awarded for the first time in October 2009.
